scope: Theorem 11.1 (Weak product comparison) of the manuscript “A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Hadwigers-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a97293542586d351), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 71. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Wn be any sequence of real functions on Kn with ∥Wn∥∞ ≤ B, where B is fixed. Extend it to the product of the single-key spaces with the same bound. For every ε > 0 there are constants L, C < ∞, independent of n, and functions Sn(k1, . . . , kr) = L X a=1 ca,n r Y j=1 fa,j,n(kj), |ca,n| ≤ C, |fa,j,n| ≤ 1, (11.1) with the following properties. (i) For arbitrary global unary functions gj,n of bound one, | Z (Wn − Sn) Y j gj,n(kj) dνn| ≤ ε (11.2) for all sufficiently large n. (ii) Under any mixed unit law satisfying (10.8), outside an exponentially small exceptional set of orientations, sup |wj|≤1 |EzAn(O, z)(Wn − Sn)(K(O, z)) Y j wj(O, zj)| ≤ ε. (11.3) The unary input weights may depend on the entire fixed orientation and on any additional marks fixed with it. The exceptional set is independent of these weights. The functions fa,j,n are global key functions; they can be chosen to be indicators of sets, or finite linear combinations of such indicators with uniformly bounded complexity. They do not depend on the sampled orientation. The constants may depend on B, ε and the fixed template and construction parameters, but not on n. An additional orientation-only filter of bound one may multiply (11.3) without changing it. In particular, after averaging normalized leaves, the same error control applies to unnormalized admissibility-filtered query measures, even when the filter is chosen using the opposite leaf. No assertion is made for an arbitrary additional joint input filter.
